Apple’s official World Travel Kit as well as the upgraded 70W and 140W Power Adapters are live alongside the new TechWoven iPad mini case at $79, however we also have the most affordable M5 MacBook Air at $200+ off as well as the return of all-time low pricing on M6 Mac mini with 24GB of RAM at $150 off, the latest AirTag 2 at the Amazon all-time low, and much more waiting below.

Touchscreen PROLED MacBook Pro pre-order deals: FREE $100 gift card, up to $1,360 off with trade

The M6 MacBook Pro has arrived, but Apple also debuted the first touchscreen Mac with the new The M6 MacBook Pro has arrived, but Apple also debuted the first touchscreen Mac with the new MacBook Pro PROLED XDR, complete with the light-up Apple logo, and pre-orders are now live. We are still awaiting the early launch deal at Amazon, but Best Buy is serving up FREE $100 gift cards with purchase and offering as much as $1,360 off the new model at trade.

PROLED XDR MacBook Pro pre-order deals

As of right now with Best Buy is delivering a FREE $100 gift card with pre-orders on any of the new touchscreen MacBook Pro models it carries:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro PROLED XDR 24GB/1TB $2,899 + $100 Best Buy gift card
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro PROLED XDR 48GB/1TB $3,699 + $100 Best Buy gift card
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro PROLED XDR 48GB/1TB $3,999 + $100 Best Buy gift card
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro PROLED XDR 48GB/2TB $5,399 + $100 Best Buy gift card
  • And even more…

As we mentioned in our M6 MacBook Pro and OLED iPad mini pre-order deal posts, as of right now Best Buy’s gift card offers are effectively the best deals available. Amazon might very well start to offer actual straight up cash discounts ahead of release next week – it could happen at anytime now, but the $100 store credit here is quite valuable, and especially so right before Black Friday deal season.

As for trades on the new PROLED XDR models, Best Buy is offering as much as $1,360 off if you flip your existing M5 machine towards the new touch model.

M6 MacBook Pro pre-order deals already live: Score a FREE $100 gift card with purchase

Alongside the new OLED iPad mini, pre-orders are now live on the all-new M6 MacBook Pro at Amazon – Apple’s most affordable new MacBook. However, Best Buy is handing out a FREE $100 gift card with purchase you won’t get at Amazon. We are not sure if Amazon is going to effectively price match this offer in some way in the coming hours, but as of right now Best Buy has the best deal on Apple’s latest M6 machine.

It’s certainly not the new PROLED XDR Display MacBook Pro with the touchscreen and light-up Apple logo around back, but it is a whole less pricey ($900 less pricey to be exact).

Again pre-orders are starting to go live at Amazon, but we are not sure whether or not it will be offering the same $100 in FREE credit as Best Buy just yet:

Over at Best Buy, starting right now, you’ll find all of these machines with a $100 gift card attached:

  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,999 + $100 Best Buy gift card
  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,199 + $100 Best Buy gift card
  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 32GB/1TB $2,399 + $100 Best Buy gift card

OLED iPad mini pre-order deals: FREE $50 gift card, up to $300 off with trade

After yestAfter yesterday’s reveal of the new touchscreen MacBook Pro, the new OLED iPad mini, M6 MacBook Pro, M6 iMac, and the MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display are now up for pre-order ahead of the early November release date. While we do expect to see some of early cash discounts landing at Amazon beforehand, Best Buy is delivering FREE gift cards with purchase of the new gear. We have already details the $100 gift card on the MacBooks, but it is also offering a FREE $50 gift card with pre-orders of the new OLED iPad mini as well.

OLED iPad mini pre-order deals

  • OLED iPad mini 128GB $699 + FREE $50 Best Buy gift card
  • OLED iPad mini 256GB $799 + FREE $50 Best Buy gift card
  • OLED iPad mini 512GB $999 + FREE $50 Best Buy gift card

Again pre-orders are also live at Amazon for the new A20 Pro-powered OLED iPad mini, but as of right now Best Buy’s $50 gift card offer is technically the best pre-order deal we have tracked yet and the lowest effective price since they went live yesterday afternoon. It would not be uncommon for Amazon to offer an early cash discount before the new iPad actually releases, but that is yet to happen.

As far as trades go, if you are looking to flip your old model for the new one, Best Buy does tend to get aggressive with trade values on some Apple gear during the pre-order phase and it is offering up to $300 off the new OLED model for those looking to flip the previous-generation models.

Most affordable M5 MacBook Air now at $200+ off (Back to best price in months)

Amazon just dropped the 24GB M6 Mac mini back to all-time low pricing at nearly $150 off

The new M6 MacBook Pro and touchscreen MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display are now up for pre-order, but you can land a likely more than powerful enough Mac for much less than that right now. Amazon is still carrying some seriously notable deals on Apple’s new entry M6 Mac mini right now starting at a fraction of the price of the new MacBooks with $120 in savings, but it has also just brought back a banger of the deal on the more powerful 24GB model at nearly $150 off.

You will find the new M6 Mac mini starting down at $779 shipped right now, but if you’re looking for some extra horsepower Amazon has just dropped the price on the new M6 Mac mini with 24GB of RAM and the 1TB SSD down to $1,149.99 shipped.

Regularly $1,299, this is $149 off the list price and on par with the best deal we have tracked since release not much more than a month ago now.

We spotted this same price drop off and on through the fall Prime Day festivities before it popped back up to full list shortly thereafter. It did catch another deal at $120 off last week, but Amazon has now decided to bring back the Prime price.

As mentioned above this 24GB deal joins notable price drops on the more affordable configs as well:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (Reg. $1,099)

Don’t pay full price to fast charge iPhone Duo with Apple’s Dynamic Power Adapter, Amazon has it for less

The iPhone Duo is out there now and Apple specifically recommends you use its 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max to fast charge the new foldable. Just don’t buy one direct, you can get it for less on Amazon right now.

Amazon is offering the official Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max down at $34.99 with free shipping for Prime members or in orders over $35. That’s not a massive deal considering you can score one straight from Apple at $39 any day of the week. But with iPhone Duo out in the wild now and Apple recommending this model for fast charging, we just wanted to make sure folks knew it can be had for less on Amazon.

First deal hits new modular Beats 360 headphones today + Cushion Kits still 80% off

Back in September Apple’s Beats brands launched the all-new modular Beats 360 over-ear headphones and today we are catching the very first straight up cash discount on the headphones themselves. Amazon is still also offering the deep 80% launch discount on the interchangeable Cushion Kits.

Amazon is now offering the new black model Beats 360 Over-Ear Headphones down at $329 shipped – the Cloud white colorway is still up at full price.

  • Beats 360 Over-Ear Headphones $329 (Reg. $350)
  • Beats 360 Cushion Kit $10 (Reg. $50)

That’s certainly not a massive discount at just $20 off, but it is the very first chance at any savings at all and we wanted to make sure it was on the radar for the remaining early adopters while the Cushion Kits were still on sale as well.

The Beats 360 feature modular a headband cushion and earpads – you can flip them out/mix and match with any of the official Cushion Kits. These kits carry $50 list prices but Amazon and Beats offered a launch deal on them at 80% off and some of them are still down at just $9.99 apiece.

For a complete rundown on the new Beats 360, head over to our hands-on review right here.

Twelve South unveils next-gen Airfly View with built-in display

Just after the reveal of its new AirFly Drive CarPlay and Android Auto wireless adapter for your ride, today Twelve South is ready to upgrade your audio experience in the air. Ready to connect directly to the in-flight entertainment system, the all-new Airfly View adds a built-in display to what was already the one of, if not, the best wireless audio transmitters for your wireless buds and headphones.

Twelve South unveils new Airfly View

Anyone familiar with the previous Airfly transmitters is going to be right at home here again. A staple in packing lists and best of travel accessory guides for years now, Twelve South is bringing its Airfly into the next-generation with the same level of simplicity, but with a new built-in display so you can actually see what’s going on.

Airfly started with one narrow problem: wireless headphones, and the wired jacks still bolted into airplane seatbacks, gym treadmills, and older cars. It has been solving that simply ever since. Airfly View keeps the same simplicity and puts every step on screen.

Airfly View is available starting today in Black and Coastal blue with an included international airline adapter and zippered hard-shell travel case at $79.99.

Twelve South Airfly Drive CarPlay and Android Auto wireless adapter has been one of the more popular tech releases around here over the last month or so, and it’s back. Shipping times started to slip well into December on the popular black model, but Amazon is now listing both it and the white for delivery as soon as next week.

Twelve South Airfly Drive (White) $40 | Nov. 1

Twelve South Airfly Drive (Black) $40 | Nov. 2 – 4

Transform your old Apple Watch into a retro-inspired handheld [Deal]

The TechPod RePod has to be one of the more compelling ways to repurpose your old Apple Watch. For around $50 with the Amazon deals right now, these things effectively bring your Apple Watch back to life, transforming it into a functional and retro-inspired handheld.

While not all models are discounted on the brand’s Amazon storefront, they do all carry a $60 list and many of them have on page coupons to knock the price down to $50.99 shipped right now. You can also save an extra 5% if you purchase two of them.

  • RePod C1 for Apple Watch $50.99 (Reg. $60)

There are RePod sizes to support just about all previous-generation Apple Watch models, going right back to Series 4, through the SE models, and right up through to Series 10 and 11. They might be one of, if not, the most interesting way to bring your old Apple wearable back to life I have seen yet.
